user.title: Track NESO flexibility events
user.description: Select the participant and numeric zone from the NESO report. Only Accepted Live events for the current UK delivery day are included.

data_description.participant: Participants are discovered from all report rows, including history.
data_description.zone: Use the NESO DFS zone number, which is different from your Home Assistant home zone.
data_description.retention_days: Default: 30 completed delivery days, plus today. Set 0 to keep today only; an ongoing overnight event remains until it ends.
